##### `IsConstruct` <a name="IsConstruct" id="@cdktn/provider-datadog.powerpackV2.PowerpackV2.isConstruct"></a>

```csharp
using Io.Cdktn.Providers.Datadog;

PowerpackV2.IsConstruct(object X);
```

Checks if `x` is a construct.

Use this method instead of `instanceof` to properly detect `Construct`
instances, even when the construct library is symlinked.

Explanation: in JavaScript, multiple copies of the `constructs` library on
disk are seen as independent, completely different libraries. As a
consequence, the class `Construct` in each copy of the `constructs` library
is seen as a different class, and an instance of one class will not test as
`instanceof` the other class. `npm install` will not create installations
like this, but users may manually symlink construct libraries together or
use a monorepo tool: in those cases, multiple copies of the `constructs`
library can be accidentally installed, and `instanceof` will behave
unpredictably. It is safest to avoid using `instanceof`, and using
this type-testing method instead.

###### `X`<sup>Required</sup> <a name="X" id="@cdktn/provider-datadog.powerpackV2.PowerpackV2.isConstruct.parameter.x"></a>

- *Type:* object

Any object.

### PowerpackV2WidgetAlertGraphDefinition <a name="PowerpackV2WidgetAlertGraphDefinition" id="@cdktn/provider-datadog.powerpackV2.PowerpackV2WidgetAlertGraphDefinition"></a>

#### Initializer <a name="Initializer" id="@cdktn/provider-datadog.powerpackV2.PowerpackV2WidgetAlertGraphDefinition.Initializer"></a>

```csharp
using Io.Cdktn.Providers.Datadog;

new PowerpackV2WidgetAlertGraphDefinition {
    string AlertId,
    string VizType,
    string Description = null,
    bool|IResolvable HideIncompleteCostData = null,
    string LiveSpan = null,
    PowerpackV2WidgetAlertGraphDefinitionTime Time = null,
    string Title = null,
    string TitleAlign = null,
    string TitleSize = null
};
```

#### Properties <a name="Properties" id="Properties"></a>

| **Name** | **Type** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <code><a href="#@cdktn/provider-datadog.powerpackV2.PowerpackV2WidgetAlertGraphDefinition.property.alertId">AlertId</a></code> | <code>string</code> | The ID of the monitor used by the widget. |
| <code><a href="#@cdktn/provider-datadog.powerpackV2.PowerpackV2WidgetAlertGraphDefinition.property.vizType">VizType</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Whether to display the Alert Graph as a timeseries or a top list. Valid values are `timeseries`, `toplist`. |
| <code><a href="#@cdktn/provider-datadog.powerpackV2.PowerpackV2WidgetAlertGraphDefinition.property.description">Description</a></code> | <code>string</code> | The description of the widget. |
| <code><a href="#@cdktn/provider-datadog.powerpackV2.PowerpackV2WidgetAlertGraphDefinition.property.hideIncompleteCostData">HideIncompleteCostData</a></code> | <code>bool\|Io.Cdktn.IResolvable</code> | Hide any portion of the widget's timeframe that is incomplete due to cost data not being available. |
| <code><a href="#@cdktn/provider-datadog.powerpackV2.PowerpackV2WidgetAlertGraphDefinition.property.liveSpan">LiveSpan</a></code> | <code>string</code> | The timeframe to use when displaying the widget. |
| <code><a href="#@cdktn/provider-datadog.powerpackV2.PowerpackV2WidgetAlertGraphDefinition.property.time">Time</a></code> | <code><a href="#@cdktn/provider-datadog.powerpackV2.PowerpackV2WidgetAlertGraphDefinitionTime">PowerpackV2WidgetAlertGraphDefinitionTime</a></code> | time block. |
